{{Quote|Our prices are light years from exorbitant and satisfaction is ensured! Buy now! Buy now! Before your enemy samples the famous bargains of Borgo.|Tuut Orial|audio=TuutOrial-BarginsOfBorgo-SC2.flac|<ref name="SC2" />}}
'''Tuut Orial''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Tuut Orial's species|alien]] [[merchant]] who sold [[flying attack droid]]s on the [[pirate]]-infested [[Borgo Prime|Port Borgo]] [[asteroid]] during the [[New Republic Era|reign]] of the [[New Republic]] around [[9 ABY]]. The [[Youngling|child]] [[KB]] watched Orial advertising the [[droid]]s to a crowd, and later her companion [[Wim]] ran into the vendor while fleeing from a group of pirates.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Death comes to all, but these bargains are rare. Watch the droids dance, friends, dazzle in their lethality!|Tuut Orial|audio=TuutOrial-DazzlingDroids-SC2.flac|<ref name="SC2" />}}
[[File:TuutOrialInjury-SC2.png|thumb|right|300px|Tuut Orial sold flying attack droids on Port Borgo.]]
The [[Gender|male]]<ref name="SC2S" /> [[Tuut Orial's species|alien]] Tuut Orial worked as a [[merchant]] from a stall on [[Borgo Prime|Port Borgo]], an [[asteroid]] frequented by [[pirate]]s.<ref name="SC2" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> during the [[New Republic Era|reign]] of the [[New Republic]], Orial was selling [[flying attack droid]]s from the stall, using some active [[droid]]s to demonstrate their abilities while calling out to advertise to potential customers. As the [[Youngling|child]] [[KB]] joined a crowd of onlookers, the alien leaped up to throw a piece of [[fruit]] in the air for one of the droids to slice through.<ref name="SC2" />

An [[Aqualish]] then poked one of the droids, causing it to strike them in the [[eye]], and Orial rushed over as the wounded Aqualish collapsed. The merchant then continued hawking their wares as one of the droids briefly chased after KB, before leaving<ref name="SC2" /> her<ref name="SC2AD">{{SkeletonCrew|Way, Way Out Past the Barrier}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> alone once she backed into her friend [[Fern]]. Orial was later standing at a table by their stall when KB's [[Skeleton Crew|companion]] [[Wim]] ran into the merchant and knocked them down while trying to escape from a [[Silvo's pirates|mob]] of pirates.<ref name="SC2" />

[[File:TuutOrialTable-SC2.png|thumb|left|300px|Wim bumped into Tuut Orial.]]
KB and Fern then confronted the pirates to save Wim and their other companion [[Neel]] as Orial slowly got up from the floor. The pirate droid [[SM-33]] then came to the children's aid, punching the pirate [[Vane]] back into Orial's stall and also<ref name="SC2" /> knocking one of the flying attack droids from the air.<ref name="SC2AD" /> The fight continued by the stall until SM-33 and the children fled, although the pirates eventually captured them.<ref name="SC2" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Are you suffering from assassination frustration?|Tuut Orial|audio=TuutOrial-AssassinationFrustration-SC2.flac|<ref name="SC2" />}}
Tuut Orial had [[Color|brown]] [[hair]] and pink skin. They advertised the lethality of their products, continuing even after a potential customer was wounded.<ref name="SC2" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|Fascinating weaponry. Absolutely novel toxicants.|Tuut Orial|audio=TuutOrial-FascinatingWeaponry-SC2.flac|<ref name="SC2" />}}
Orial wore brown [[Clothing|robes]] and black [[glove]]s. Their stall displayed many flying attack droids, which Orial described as fascinating with novel [[Poison|toxicants]].<ref name="SC2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tuut Orial was portrayed by [[Alan Resnick]] in "[[Way, Way Out Past the Barrier]],"<ref name="SC2" /> the second episode of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', which aired on [[December 2]], [[2024]].<ref name="Early">{{SW|url=news/skeleton-crew-premiere-date|text=''Star Wars: Skeleton Crew'' Will Debut Early|date=2024-11-26}}</ref> The character's name was not spoken in the episode but appeared in the credits,<ref name="SC2" /> with Resnick confirming which character was Orial on social media.<ref name="Threads">{{Threads|alanresnick|post/DDIAuc6SPvD|[[Alan Resnick]]|date=2024-12-03|quote=Many, many people in my life told me I would never ever be in Star Wars... but yesterday, for a brief moment, I was. I saw a droid punch a guy and a little kid knocked me over. For me, this was a dream come true! This is canon.|archivedate=20250118211828}}</ref> Tuut Orial is a [[Tuckerization|partial anagram]]<ref name="SC2" /> of the name of Resnick's [[Wikipedia:YouTube|YouTube]] channel, "[https://www.youtube.com/user/alantutorial alantutorial]."<ref name="Resnick">{{WebCite|url=https://alanresnick.info/|text=Alan Resnick|work=[https://alanresnick.info/ Alan Resnick]|archivedate=20241227022713}}</ref>
